title: The 1895 Death Ray That Tesla Destroyed with His Bare Hands
hook: Nikola Tesla built a particle beam weapon that could destroy armies from 200 miles away—then he smashed it to pieces and took the plans to his grave.
why_this_can_go_viral: Tesla is a proven viral draw, and the idea of a genius destroying his own world-changing weapon triggers intense curiosity and conspiracy framing.

title: The 1950s Soviet 'Earth Breather' That Tunneled 3 Miles in a Week
hook: KGB engineers built a nuclear-powered mole machine that melted through rock at 50 feet per hour—until it disappeared into the Earth and was never recovered.
why_this_can_go_viral: Lost Soviet technology + mysterious disappearance + nuclear-powered horror = irresistible clickbait for the lost tech audience.

title: The 1,500-Year-Old Glass That Bent Light Like a Lens

why_this_can_go_viral: Nazi super-weapons are a proven viral category; the sonic blade concept is unique and visually terrifying.

title: The 6,000-Year-Old Danubian 'Furnace City' That Melted Copper at 1,200°C

why_this_can_go_viral: Ancient technological sophistication plus deliberate destruction by modern authorities creates a compelling mystery.

why_this_can_go_viral: Mind-reading technology that became a dark weapon is a perfect blend of sci-fi and historical horror.

title: The 1970s British 'Rubber Road' That Swallowed Cars Entirely

title: The 1940s Japanese 'Kamikaze Rocket' That Surpassed Modern Missiles

title: The 2,300-Year-Old Greek 'Air Conditioner' That Cooled an Entire Palace

title: The 1965 Soviet 'Brain Stimulator' That Made Soldiers Feel No Pain

title: The 12th Century Khmer 'Hydraulic Ram' That Pumped Water Uphill
hook: Angkor Wat's engineers used a water hammer effect to push the Tonle Sap river up 50 feet into city reservoirs—the physics baffled modern hydrologists for centuries.
why_this_can_go_viral: Ancient infrastructure that stumps modern science is a reliable curiosity driver with high educational shareability.

title: The 1970s CIA 'Mind-Control Radio' That Broadcast Hallucinations

title: The 1906 Californian 'Earthquake Engine' That Stopped Shaking

title: The 1950s French 'Radioactive Battery' That Lasted 100 Years

why_this_can_go_viral: A century-long battery that could end disposable electronics but was hidden by government is a perfect lost tech narrative.
